item.title: AMAWULIRE ERI ABATAWULIRA: Baabano abayambye bannaabwe okugoberera ebigenda mu maaso - NTV Uganda
item.description: Amatendekero agawaggula gasabiddwa okulaba nga gakwatagana n’amakolero bwegabeera gabaga ebisomesebwa abayizi kiyambeko okutumbula obuyiiya.Mu kino namatendekero gasabiddwa okwetonderawo obukolero obutono kisoboseze abayizi okwongera okubeera abayiiya.

item.title: OMUSOLO KU MAFUTA: Waliwo abasabye gav’t yeesonyiwe eby’okugwongeza - NTV Uganda
item.description: Abali mu mulimu gw’okusaabaza abantu baagala gavumenti eggye enta mu biyitingana nga bwerina enteekateeka ez’okwongeza omusolo ku mafuta nga bagamba nti kigenda kuviirako akatuubaagiro k’ebyenfuna eri abantu baabulijjo kubanga buli kintu kigenda kuba kyolekedde okulinnya ebbeeyi.Kino bakyesigamizza ku biteeso ebyasomoddwa okuva mu nsonda ezeesigika nga biraga nga gavumenti bwerina ekirowoozo ky’okukola enkyuukakyuka mu by’emisolo ng’ebintu

item.title: OKUTUNDA ZZAABU EBWERU: Akakiiko kazudde ng’owa Uganda akukusibwa kuva mu Congo - NTV Uganda
item.description: Kizuuse nti Uganda zzaabu gw’etunda ebweru w’eggwanga ate asooka kukukusibwa okuva mu ggwanga lya Democratic Republic of Congo nga basoose kumulongoosa.Bino bizuuliddwa mu kakiiko ka palamenti akalondoola ebyenfuna by’eggwanga ababaka abatuulako bwe babadde bagasimbaganye n’abakulu okuva mu ministry y’eby’ensimbi nga bazze okunnyonnyola eggwanga bwe liyimiridde mu by’enfuna.Okusinziira ku ministry, eby’enfuna kati bikulira ku misinde gya

item.title: NNAMBA ZA DIGITO: Katushabe asambazze ebigambibwa nti ssi ntuufu - NTV Uganda
item.description: Ministry y'eby’entambula esambazze ebyogerwa nti ebya namba za digitala bya kifere .Omubaka wa Bugabula County South Maurice Henry Kibalya, yayogedde nti pulojekiti eno yandiba nga yali yakifere ababaka bwebabadde bagasimbaganye n’abakulu mu minisitule eno.Wabula komisona Winstone Katushabe, ategeezezza nti emirimu gibadde gitambula nga namba plate ezikunukkiriza mu mitwalo 30 zezakateekebwa ku motoka.

item.title: ABAAKUUMA BOBI MU KALULU: Mukyala w’omu ku bapoliisi abakwate, akukkulumidde gav’t - NTV Uganda
item.description: Omu ku bakyala b’abasirikale abaali bakuuma Robert Kyagulanyi mu kampeyini ayagala Kyagulanyi ne gavumenti baveeyo batangaze ekyakwasisa abaami baabwe.Agamba mu kifo ky’okusasula omwami we olw’emirimu gye yakola, asasuddwamu kusibwa nga n’ensonga ezibasibya teri y’avuddeyo kuzirambulula okuva ku gwe baakuuma n’abaabasindika okukuuma.
